comment: Licence policy for Go modules linked into nassimhub-agent, enforced by scripts/sbom.py. 'allowed' lists SPDX identifiers the project accepts for code combined with its AGPL-3.0-only agent; it is a project policy for reviewers, not legal advice. A module whose licence is NOASSERTION (no licence file, or a text the tool does not recognise) or is not in 'allowed' fails the check unless 'allowlist' has an entry for that exact module AND version with a non-empty reason written by the person who reviewed it: {"module": "example.invalid/mod", "version": "v1.2.3", "licence": "<what the reviewer found>", "reason": "<why it is acceptable, and where the licence was confirmed>"}.
